dispositions.reason: Home recents and History rows share useOpenHistorySession; the incompatible fallback is exercised on History, where a not-started record is listed.
The suggestion needs a multi-week pattern history; its Card composition is shared with Train today and is covered by Home.test.tsx.
Restart with an active session raises the shared workout-chrome confirmation, whose after evidence belongs to the workout lifecycle group.
The guard sends a user with no onboarded profile to /onboarding; the empty branch is unreachable through the route.
A failed Boot-watched profile read is answered by Boot’s own retry before Settings mounts; the Settings footer Retry is covered by the mounted component test.
The profile read is Boot-watched; BootGate withholds the route tree while it is pending, so Boot is the native surface.
A failed Boot-watched locations read is answered by Boot’s retry before this route mounts; the footer Retry branch is covered by the mounted component test.
The locations read is Boot-watched; BootGate withholds the route tree while it is pending.

observations.text: A completed recent whose stored prescription validates opens in Review, not Session Detail.
A completed, valid record opens Review; a never-started record follows its durable /history/:id fallback into Session Detail.
A held then failed page read keeps the one card and puts Retry in the footer; Retry re-reads and Load older workouts widens the window to the remaining records.
A typed settings_not_viable refusal rolls the control back to the stored value and says so; the stored profile still reads experience_level=some.
After a full reload the saved Confident experience and the Hard conditioning limitation are still selected, and the stored profile reads experience_level=confident.
Another user’s completed record and a random id both answer Workout not found with no sections disclosed; Open history returns to /history.
Back on a directly entered record goes to /history; Back on a record opened from History returns to the prior in-app route.
Choosing a skin writes clear.skin and data-skin through the picker; the stored key is what boot applies on reload (the same path every capture here uses to pin its skin).
Create then rename are real save_location writes: after a full reload the renamed place is listed and stored once.
History is one Workout history card: the filter, rows and every state are its content, rows are list items with inset rules and no frame, and Load older workouts sits in the pinned footer.
Home groups are Train today, This week and the Recent workouts / Favorites tab panel: each a current Card with its 12px accent bar and an internal heading, none nested.
Save as favorite wrote one saved_workouts row for the owner; the Favorites tab lists it after a full reload.
Saving a nameless place is refused before any write: the Name field is marked invalid and takes focus.

Session Detail: one Overview card holds the facts (dl), provenance and the Mood/Notes sub-groups, each with a ruled heading; each section is one card whose later blocks are separated by an internal rule; the outline never skips a level.
Settings is five landmark sections, each a current card with a 12px bar and its heading inside: Training, Limitations, Appearance, Places and equipment, Session.
The default cannot be deleted until another place is made default; a failed default change rolls back; the confirmed delete removes the stored row and survives reload.

Use this follows the actual recommendation path. Dismiss persists for today across reload and Generate opens without suggestion-prefill query parameters; the form independently derives its recommendation from the same history. No Generate/Quick start/model POST was submitted.
With an active session the footer is Resume workout and leads to /workout; Generate workout is not offered.
A disposable namespaced user onboarded through complete_onboarding; sessions are written with persist_session/start_session/complete_session, the favorite through the app’s own Save as favorite.

A disposable namespaced user with one onboarded place; creates, renames, default changes and deletes are real writes. Only the named equipment read, default change and viability refusal are answered locally for that user.
A disposable namespaced user; one completed reviewable record, one never-started record and twenty-one older prescriptions written through persist_session.
A disposable namespaced user; the first experience PATCH is held then answered with the typed settings_not_viable refusal, every later write is the real endpoint.

A real disposable actor with one recent completed RPC-written session qualifies under the installed minimum-history rule. Expected recommendation/path are derived from the actual owned rows, not a mocked Home suggestion or a model response.

Additive representative layouts only: non-phone projects add all four skins; the phone project adds all four short-phone skins. Existing full-phone skin evidence and every original record/picture are retained. This is not every state/skin/width combination or deployed proof.

Responsive palette sampling uses the existing owned screenshot fixture to set the stored skin and document attribute; real appearance-picker persistence and selection remain asserted in the original settings case. These are layout pictures, not new preference behavior.
Two disposable namespaced users. The viewer owns a logged completed record, an unlogged completed record and a never-started record; the other user owns one completed record.
A section heading is a disclosure button: Enter toggles aria-expanded, and the focused trigger is bracketed.
The Goal radiogroup is reached by Tab and framed by the static bracket layer.
The Home tablist is the package TabBar: ArrowRight moves focus and selection from Recent workouts to Favorites, and the bracket layer frames the focused tab.
The Show filter is a native select reached by Tab; as a field it owns its focus.
The delete confirmation is a native dialog: focus is held inside it while open and Escape dismisses it without deleting.
The limitations note owns its focus: the bracket layer stays hidden on a text field.
Home’s three groups arrive as one .clr-boot set, 40ms apart, once; switching tabs is an inline update and replays nothing.

Under prefers-reduced-motion Settings comes to rest after reload with no animation or transition left running.
